work.title: A Midsummer Night's Dream
work.note: A Midsummer Night's Dream é uma comédia de William Shakespeare, escrita por volta de 1595 e 1596. A aula retorna à obra para explorar “verbos de ver: watch the parade (assistir ao desfile) e see the fireworks (ver os fogos)”. A referência mostra uma festa de verão: watch the parade, see the fireworks.

facts.label: Tour do campus
facts.sub: Muitas faculdades americanas oferecem tours com alunos-guias. Eles mostram as salas, a biblioteca e os dormitórios, contam como é a vida no campus e respondem a todas as perguntas dos visitantes.

pages.title: Brick and green grass · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a sunny Saturday at a big college in Boston. Groups of visitors walk across a green lawn. Nico looks at the old brick buildings. He wants to study here next year. A student in a red shirt stands by a sign. Her name is Eva.
“Hi! Welcome to our college tour. I am Eva.” says Eva. “Hi, Eva. I am Nico. I am a visitor.” says Nico. “Nice to meet you. What subjects do you like?” says Eva.

pages.title: Brick and green grass · 3/3
paragraphs: “Do students live on campus?” says Nico. “Yes, many do. I live in a dorm with a friend.” says Eva. Eva shows Nico the science building and the library. They have lunch in the cafeteria with other visitors. Nico sees a small room in a dorm. He asks many questions and writes notes. At the end, Eva gives him a map and a pen. A good visit helps you choose your future.
